asset.name: Hollow Delve timber gallery
asset.visual_description:
A low excavated gallery follows a seam through damp blue-grey limestone.
Heavy dark timber uprights brace the rear wall, their feet resting on stacks of
stone shims. Rusted iron straps bind split beams. Two small oil lamps hang from
iron hooks. A level haulage shelf is worn smooth through its middle, with loose
gravel and a shallow drainage groove along the back edge. Uneven rock presses
between the supports, and dark recesses open beyond the last pools of lamplight.
